name: Flashforge Guider 2s 0.4 nozzle
pre_gcode: M140 S{bed_temp}; set initial bed temp
M104 S{temp} T0; set initial extruder temp
M132 X Y A B; recall home offsets from EPROM
M7; wait for bed to stabilize
M6 T0; wait for extruder to stabilize
G1 Z0.3 F3600; move down to purge
G1 X120 Y-125 E20 F2000; extrude a line of filament across the front edge of the bed
G1 X130 Y-125 F180; wait for ooze
G1 X140 Y-125 F5000; fast wipe
post_gcode: M104 S0 T0; cool down extruder
M140 S0 T0; cool down bed
M132 X Y A B; recall home offsets from EPROM
fan_gcode: M106 S{fan_speed}  ; p3d: add for orca slicer
